description: Allows you to rebind more keybindings. Furthermore, adds an unbind button and allows escape to be rebound!

mods.name: RebindMyKeys
mods.description: Allows you to rebind keybindings which normally are hardcoded.

releases.notes:
### Don't use this to daily Minecraft!

It's fine to try it out, but I still have a lot of bugs to fix before this mod is actually usable (and also a lot of UI/UX design).
If you have any design suggestions, I would love to hear them :)

------

This is the first alpha after the rewrite of everything.
I'm not releasing this on modrinth as people could accidentally download it thinking it's a fully working mod.

Because of that, a **build jar** is also attached.

------

To use this with Minecraft, simply set up a fabric environment for 1.20.4. Then install `fabric-api`. And finally put the `RebindMyKeys-3.0+alpha3-mc1.20.jar` file in your mods folder
